project.title: [Company] — AI Reception Implementation
project.summary: AI Receptionist deployment for 24/7 patient enquiry handling, voice and chat, with calendar booking and SMS/email confirmations.
objectives: 24/7 AI voice receptionist for inbound calls
AI chat widget for website enquiries (WhatsApp, Instagram, web chat)
Automated calendar booking with real-time availability
SMS and email confirmations for all bookings
Knowledge base setup for accurate treatment/pricing responses

included: AI Receptionist voice agent configuration and deployment
AI chat widget integration (website, WhatsApp, Instagram DM)
SMS/email confirmation automation for bookings and enquiries
Knowledge base build: treatments, pricing, FAQs, policies
Call forwarding and escalation rules setup
exclusions: Phone number provisioning (client provides or ports)
Ongoing message/call minutes beyond included allowance
Custom integrations beyond calendar and standard channels
Content creation for knowledge base (client provides source material)

timeline.notes: Estimated; final schedule confirmed at agreement

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Provide phone number for forwarding or porting
Supply treatment/pricing/FAQ content for knowledge base
assumptions: Implementation fee is one-off; monthly fee starts at Go-Live
AI message/call minutes subject to fair usage within included allowance
No third-party costs (Twilio, OpenAI, etc.) beyond included allowance without prior approval
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement is executed before invoicing
